Phaser 3.88.2
Upstream: https://github.com/phaserjs/phaser/releases/tag/v3.88.2
Local file: js/vendor/phaser.min.js
Loaded only by studio-preview.html. Other Lead.web pages do not include it.

The studio scene, furniture, plants, robot and two characters are original
pixel art rasterized in js/studio-preview.js. No sprites, logos or textures
were taken from claude-office, PostHog PMF-game, or the reference image.
Those projects were not copied into this repository.
